items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I never heard Lester Nelson. They say he was good. Yeah, he was good.

ctx.x: No. Just a plain old melody. I don't know if somebody has to tell me that. I haven't analyzed myself. I haven't tried to cop anybody's style. I just... Just hanging around the melody and that's it, you know?
Well, you know, I stop and I think about the different saxophone players that I heard. I heard Edie Miller and Lester Lushon here. Oh yeah, Ed Lushon.

I never heard Lester Nelson. They say he was good. Yeah, he was good. He and Australia used to team up things. Oh yeah. And what was another saxophone? I think they had three, sometimes they had three tenner sometimes. Oh, some big.
